item.title: Great Zimbabwe
item.description: I recently got the opportunity to play the game “Great Zimbabwe.” I found it to be a very interesting game, with several mechanics that I hadn’t really seen in other games. I don’t think it will ever be a top game for me (for reasons outlined below), but I did find myself thinking about it for days after playing, so I figured I’d share my thoughts. An important caveat to all of the below is that I am a total novice (with one game under my belt, played against other novices), so I definitely don’t understand all of the complexity that attracts some people to play the game repeatedly.
